text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Omar Bongo of Gabon met on Tuesday with Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos. The two spoke about the crisis in Zaire.
- Albino Malungo, the Minister of Assistance and Social Reintegration, met on Tuesday with provincial delegates to map out a strategy for returning refugees and other issues for the coming year.
- The Central Committee of the MPLA said on Tuesday it was worried about the continued undeclared strike by the teachers' union and urged the government to find a solution to the problem.
